rule.name: EarlyWaitOnStartedWork
rule.message: This waits with get() or join() for a Future started earlier, but its result is first used only after later statements that do not use it. While this waits, nothing else runs. Move the wait to where the result is first used, so that the independent work overlaps with the task. An exception fits only when the later work relies on the task having finished (shared state, a file or row the task writes, a required order).

property.name: xpath
property.value: //Block[not(parent::TryStatement)]/LocalVariableDeclaration [count(VariableDeclarator) = 1] [VariableDeclarator/MethodCall[(@MethodName = 'get' and ArgumentList/@Size = (0, 2)) or (@MethodName = 'join' and ArgumentList/@Size = 0)] [*[1][self::VariableAccess][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.concurrent.Future')]]] [let $at := count(preceding-sibling::*), $name := VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name, $task := VariableDeclarator/MethodCall/*[1]/@Name, $users := following-sibling::*[descendant::VariableAccess[@Name = $name]], $first := if (exists($users)) then count($users[1]/preceding-sibling::*) else -1, $between := following-sibling::*[count(preceding-sibling::*) lt $first] return $first - $at ge 3 and not(matches($task, '^(lock|mutex|barrier|ready|init|initialized|shutdown|flush|close|closed|drain|drained|limit|limiter|sleep|delay|wait|done|exit|exited|end|ended|finish|finished|complete|completed|completion|settled|stop|stopped)([A-Z0-9_]|$)|(Lock|Mutex|Barrier|Ready|Init|Initialized|Shutdown|Flush|Close|Closed|Drain|Drained|Limit|Limiter|Sleep|Delay|Wait|Done|Exit|Exited|End|Ended|Finish|Finished|Complete|Completed|Completion|Settled|Stop|Stopped)([A-Z0-9_]|$)')) and exists(parent::Block/LocalVariableDeclaration[VariableDeclarator/VariableId/@Name = $task] [VariableDeclarator/MethodCall[@MethodName = ('supplyAsync', 'runAsync', 'submit', 'schedule', 'sendAsync')]] [count(preceding-sibling::*) lt $at]) and exists($between//MethodCall [not(matches(@MethodName, '^(get|is|has)([A-Z]|$)|^(join|log|trace|debug|info|warn|error)$'))] [not(*[1][self::TypeExpression][pmd-java:typeIs('java.lang.Math')])]) and empty($between/descendant-or-self::*[self::ReturnStatement or self::ThrowStatement or self::BreakStatement or self::ContinueStatement]) and empty($between//VariableAccess[@Name = $task])]
